name: room-eval2-redo: five walls redrawn after the owner's review of 25 Oct 2026 (MOTH-94 to MOTH-101), the approved walls attached as finished neighbours
notes: The owner's recorded review (25 Oct 2026): one bunk, every wall lining up; the sofa on one wall only; the ladder at the same end everywhere. The specifications were corrected from the floor plan and checked with evals/images/roomcheck.py before these prompts were built (checklist 68 and 69).
k2 ('perfect'), m1 ('perfect'), m3 and the corridor stay as drawn; they are attached here as the finished neighbours the redrawn walls must agree with.
The real charge lands in results and goes in the level file's ledger as re-dos.

cases.prompt_prefix:
Attached picture 1 is a plain layout sketch of this wall: grey boxes mark exactly where each item in the list below stands, in the same left-to-right order as the list; the grey blocks on the two side walls mark where the neighbouring walls' ends show; the line across the back wall is the top of the painted band. Follow its positions exactly and ignore its look entirely; it is a plan, not the style.

Attached picture 2 is the bunk wall (east), to the right of the window wall of this same room, finished; it is immediately to the RIGHT of this wall (a player turning right from this wall sees it); the right corner of this picture is the left corner of that one. Match its style, hand, palette, the height of its band, its floor and its light exactly, so the room is one room. Do not copy its furniture; draw only what is listed below.
